Some good performances in this match with Jessica Palmer once again outstanding in the sprints, and good performances from Cindy James, Angela Abrams and Rachael Parrott.
Two Club Records fell - Cindy James in the Junior Discus and Jenny Webb knocking nearly a minute off the previous Intermediate 3000m record.
